pages.title: Automatic Mating
pages.text: Domesticated animals mate automatically!$(br2)When a domesticated male and female are near each other, the female has a chance to become pregnant. She must have at least 80% hunger and not be in post-birth cooldown.

pages.title: Pregnancy & Birth
pages.text: Pregnancy lasts about 120 minutes for cows (scaled by body size). Pregnant animals eat 1.5x faster and their belly grows bigger.$(br2)When the time comes, live-bearing animals give birth to a baby that is $(bold)domesticated from birth$().$(br2)That baby will not grow up on its own like in vanilla - a domesticated baby must be kept well fed. See $(l:animalflee:growth/growth_overview)Raising Young$().

pages.title: Oviparous Animals
pages.text: Oviparous animals (like chickens) do NOT get pregnant! Instead, they lay eggs on a fixed cycle.$(br2)A female oviparous animal lays an egg about every 1 MC day. If a qualified male is nearby, she lays a fertilized egg; otherwise she lays a normal egg.$(br2)Both wild and domesticated oviparous animals lay eggs.
Keep your cows well-fed and a bull nearby. A pregnant cow that takes damage has a chance to miscarry, so protect her!
